races.title: Watch On Racing TV Juvenile Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: ELM CREEK has shown enough in 2 hurdles starts to land a race of this nature. Guevara may prove the biggest danger on the back of his Flat form, with Irish raider Shushi the type to improve on her recent debut in this sphere. ELM CREEK (IRE) GUEVARA (GER) SHUSHI

races.title: Musselburgh Racecourse Premium Annual Membership Handicap Chase
races.verdict: FLASH DU PISTOLET has gradually edged back down to his last winning mark and can end his losing run with a recent outing behind him. Chasing debut winner Nevershedatear should go close in her attempt to follow up, whilst Humble Jumble isn't one to completely rule out. FLASH DU PISTOLET (IRE) NEVERSHEDATEAR (IRE) HUMBLE JUMBLE (IRE)
